title: Almost impossible to cancel
text:
The first project was a hit, the second won’t be made so the recipient asked me to cancel the subscription. I went online and tried to cancel - it didn’t work and was told to call. I waited on hold 39 minutes and some seconds. Yolanda on the phone didn’t apologize when I mentioned the wait. When I mentioned I wasn’t able to cancel online she said it’s because I did it wrong. I asked her to please let management know their system may need to be relooked at because it is not user friendly, and she again said I did it wrong. At that point I promised to leave a review with my experience and said goodbye.

If you don’t even plan to cancel and if you don’t mind unfinished projects this is a fine product.
label: negative
